title: SECTION IV — MEANING, LANGUAGE AND THE LIGHT OF FOLK LIFE
summary: A broad sequence of short meditations on meaning in lived life. Words, work, hunger, equality, craft, colour, play, desire, social encounter and the ordinary objects of home and village become occasions for asking how meaning is made. The section repeatedly moves from solitary perception toward shared space and from abstract questions back to hands, feet, food, tools and speech.
